whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Koyla De barbeque,

I noticed your restaurant has phenomenal 4.0★ reviews across 1,400+ food lovers in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page.

Maine aapke barbeque restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, signature menu items, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://arclane-studios.github.io/koyla-de-barbeque-patna

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Koyla De barbeque, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, signature barbecue menu showcase, and your Kankarbagh location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes aur pricing setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
